# Gemini CLI Commands

This document provides a comprehensive reference for all the commands available in the Gemini CLI.

## Core Commands

### `gemini [prompt]`

This is the primary command for interacting with the Gemini model. You can provide a prompt directly as an argument.

* **`-p, --prompt <prompt>`**: The prompt to send to the model. You can also provide the prompt as the last argument without the flag.
* **`--all_files`**: Includes all files in the current project in the context.
* **`@<file_or_directory>`**: A syntax to reference files or directories in your prompt.

**Example:**
```bash
gemini "what is the purpose of the main function in this file? @src/main.js"
